description: Contract between Planasia platform and external AI vector generation agents connected via API.
platformResponsibilities: Provide complete drawing standards bundle (DPT layouts + Titan Box title block)
Provide structured project data (HousePlanDocument) per export job
Provide per-sheet vector generation specifications with required elements and acceptance criteria
Validate reference files exist and sheet index is complete before dispatch
Orchestrate multi-sheet PDF assembly after agent returns vector primitives or sheet PDFs
agentResponsibilities: Generate 100% pure vector geometry per sheet-vector-specs.json
Strictly follow DPT Golden Standard layout conventions for each sheet type
Render Titan Box title block on every sheet using provided field values (do not invent layout)
Use coordinate system and units defined in vector-output-spec.json
Return output in the agreed response format (see responseSchema)

sheetCode.description: DPT sheet code e.g. A2.00, S1.00, SN-01

standards.description: Subset of drawing standards bundle (layout authority, title block, output spec)

sheetSpec.description: Entry from sheet-vector-specs.json for this sheet/renderer

titleBlockFields.description: Resolved title block field values for this sheet

referenceFiles.description: Paths to DPT reference DWG and Titan Box title block files

vectorPrimitives.description: Array of vector primitive commands (see vector-output-spec.json primitiveTypes)

sheetPdfBase64.description: Optional: single-sheet A3 landscape PDF as base64 if agent renders full page

authentication.note: Configure via VECTOR_AGENT_API_KEY env on platform; agent presents Bearer token

dispatchModes.perSheet: One API call per sheet — recommended for incremental rollout
dispatchModes.perPhase: One API call per DPT drawing phase (cover-index, floor-layouts, etc.)
dispatchModes.fullSet: One API call for entire drawing set — requires agent capacity for ~28 sheets
